glosses: A short break in the action of a sport, for substitution, consultation, etc.

examples.text: We're being beaten! We need a time-out!

glosses: A break from a tense, heated or stressful situation (often enforced, sometimes as a disciplinary measure); a cooling-off period.

examples.text: I'm going to take a brief time-out from this job.
Hitting people is not acceptable! Go to your room and take a time-out!
As punishment, my mom gave me a 15-minute time-out.

glosses: The abortion of an incomplete task after a time limit considered long enough for it to end normally.

examples.text: Pratiquez le français pendant vos temps morts.
